baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 2, 3, 5, and 6 join vessels in motion, elevation or construction, the sea, and comparison to conspicuous heights.
baseline_models.mechanism: Horizontal flow crosses vertical lift: vessels become conspicuous when their sails or structures rise over broad water, so the comparison supplies landmark function as well as mountain scale.

activation_trace.role: Ordinary running and flowing explicitly includes ships and supplies horizontal maritime motion.
Rising and being raised explicitly includes lifted sails and supplies the fleet's vertical profile.
Broad abundant water supplies the expansive field across which the raised forms become visible.
A distinguishing mark, banner, or mountain landmark turns sheer height into orientation and recognition.

changed_reading.before: Large ships float on the sea and resemble mountains.
changed_reading.after: Sail-raised moving vessels are mobile landmarks: flow is made vertically legible across the sea.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possession clause and words 2-5 permit the vessels to be read as originated infrastructure for continuing sea travel.
baseline_models.mechanism: Origination and ongoing grant coexist with the raised-sail reading. The fleet is not merely an owned collection but a made and maintained channel through which benefit can keep moving.

activation_trace.role: Continuing provision or grant gives the vessels a sustained-benefit function rather than one-time motion.
Bringing something into being supplies the fleet's originated or constructed aspect.
Sea travel supplies the practical domain in which originated benefit is circulated.
The visible landmark makes the otherwise distributed benefit publicly perceivable.

changed_reading.after: The vessels are originated, visible channels of continuing maritime benefit under the stated ownership.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 2, 3, and 6 can describe course, departure and return, and orientation rather than only physical objects.
baseline_models.mechanism: Customary coursing, setting out, sea travel, and landmarks combine into a route system. The plural fleet stands for an organized regime of departures, returns, and navigable ways.

activation_trace.role: A habitual course or way turns repeated vessel movement into an established route.
Setting out, coming, and turning toward supplies departure and return within the route system.
Sea travel fixes the system in a concrete navigational domain.
Road, boundary, banner, and mountain marks supply guidance and recognizable position.

changed_reading.after: The fleet condenses an entire maritime system of coursing, setting out, return, and orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence couples teaching with disclosure. When the focus later compares vessels to marks or landmarks, their visibility can communicate order and ownership rather than merely report size.

activation_trace.role: A mark that distinguishes and guides gives the focus comparison a semiotic function.
Knowledge becoming clear through teaching activates the shared root as a mode of intelligibility.
Meaning disclosed by speech or sign supplies the arrow from visible vessel to communicated order.

structural_cues: 55:2 and 55:4 frame creation with teaching and clarification before the focus comparison.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies teaching, disclosure, and a focus landmark; I infer a backward semiotic link from sequence and repeated root. The live alternative is that word 6 remains only a concrete mountain comparison.

changed_reading.after: Mountain or landmark likeness also makes the moving fleet readable as public instruction in order and ownership.

context_deltas.mechanism: Calculated celestial movement, a raised sky, and balanced alignment revise maritime routing into a terrestrial analogue of measured coursing. Raised sails locally join horizontal motion to the surah's vertical order.

activation_trace.role: The flowing branch explicitly spans both ship sailing and solar running, permitting the analogy.
Raised sails make elevation part of maritime movement rather than a separate static feature.
Counting and calculation supply measure to the preceding sun-moon course.
Elevation of the sky provides the larger vertical pattern echoed by sail lift.
Balancing and aligning two things supplies relational order rather than isolated measurement.

structural_cues: 55:5 places sun and moon under calculation, while 55:7 pairs the raised sky with the balance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shared flowing, calculation, elevation, and alignment; I infer that the maritime scene echoes rather than duplicates cosmic order. Alternatively, the two ordered domains may remain parallel without mutual interpretation.

changed_reading.after: Their routes and raised profiles become a local, visible enactment of measured coursing within a larger ordered world.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sea is no blank backdrop: two mobile expanses are released into encounter, remain related through an interval that blocks transgression, and yield what was hidden. The focus fleet becomes the conspicuous mobile beneficiary and index of that bounded interface.

activation_trace.role: Vessel flow supplies mobile participation in the preceding sea process.
Broad abundant water anchors the process in the focus rather than letting context become an independent theme.
Release into open ranging supplies mobility to the two seas.
Two opposed things arriving together supplies active convergence.
An interval between two things supplies separation without eliminating relation.
Crossing a limit by aggression defines the failure that the barrier prevents.
Bringing something out of concealment makes the regulated interface visibly productive.

structural_cues: 55:19-22 moves from release, to meeting, to non-transgression, to emergence immediately before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies convergence, interval, limit, and emergence; I assign the ships the role of moving through and displaying the regulated interface. The live alternative is simple juxtaposition: vessels follow the sea sequence without operating within its mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The sea is scenery beneath monumental vessels.
changed_reading.after: The vessels visibly inhabit a productive contact zone whose mobility depends on preserved limits.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate refrain classifies the fleet within benefits governed by lordship. Possession is therefore not only dominion over impressive objects but beneficent provision offered to the two addressed communities.

activation_trace.role: Continuing grant supplies the focus model that the refrain can strengthen as bounty.
Origination makes the fleet a bestowed facility rather than a self-grounding possession.
Benefits and favors explicitly classify what the refrain asks the audience to acknowledge.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty explain the possessive frame as governed benefit.

structural_cues: 55:25 places the recurring dual-address refrain directly after the focus verse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate rhetorical classification as favors under lordship; I take the ships as the nearest antecedent while allowing that the refrain also gathers the whole preceding series.

changed_reading.before: The ownership clause asserts sovereignty over vessels.
changed_reading.after: The ownership clause presents maritime mobility itself as a governed favor to be acknowledged.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next contrast breaks the easy equation of mountain-like size with permanence. Raised vessels may be monumental and publicly marked, yet their originated form belongs to what passes; only the stated enduring presence remains.

activation_trace.role: Origination places the constructed fleet on the side of what has come into being.
Mountain-scale landmark visibility creates the apparent monumentality that context qualifies.
Cessation and disappearance after duration withdraw permanence from created forms.
Endurance supplies the contrastive pole reserved for what remains.

structural_cues: 55:26-27 immediately opposes universal passing-away to singular remaining.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies origination, monumentality, passing, and remaining; I infer that the contrast reaches the focus constructions. A narrower alternative limits 55:26 chiefly to living inhabitants rather than artifacts.

changed_reading.before: Mountain-like vessels image durable human monumentality.
changed_reading.after: Their monumentality is conspicuous but temporary, functioning as a sign rather than a rival permanence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Requests, recurring temporal action, flowing springs, gushing water, and closing growing good extend the fleet's continuing-grant branch. Maritime benefit becomes one instance of provision repeatedly kept in motion, not a finished artifact left to itself.

activation_trace.role: Continuing provision supplies the focus-side model of maintained benefit.
Origination supplies the made form whose continuance now requires an active temporal reading.
Request and asking supply recurrent dependence rather than autonomous operation.
A duration of time supplies recurrence to the activity.
An affair, state, or active concern supplies ongoing engagement.
A spring as the source of running water gives provision an ecological source.
The repeated root explicitly reconnects water flow with continuing grant.
Abundant water welling up intensifies the model from simple flow to replenishment.
Stable, growing good closes the sequence by joining continuance to increase.

structural_cues: 55:29 makes every temporal cycle active; 55:50 and 55:66 repeat supplied water in motion; 55:78 closes with enduring growth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurring dependence, active concern, replenished flow, and growing good; I infer that the focus fleet participates in that maintained circulation. The alternative is a looser catalog of independent favors with no shared operational cycle.

changed_reading.before: The fleet is a completed gift available for travel.
changed_reading.after: The fleet belongs to a recurrently sustained circulation in which sources, movement, and benefit are continually renewed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The challenge of passing beyond terrestrial and celestial edges tests the route model's limit. Ships demonstrate real passage within a granted domain, but their mobility cannot be generalized into unrestricted escape; passage requires effective authority.

activation_trace.role: Actual ship movement supplies a concrete case of successful traversal.
Setting out and coming or going gives the fleet directional reach.
Boundary and road marks make passage domain-aware rather than limitless.
Clean passage through to the far side states the traversal being challenged.
Edges and regions define the larger boundary across which passage is sought.
Effective power and delegated authority supply the condition for crossing.

structural_cues: 55:33 addresses both communities and repeats the traversal verb before making authority its exception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordinary maritime traversal and a later boundary challenge conditioned by authority; I treat the fleet as a bounded analogue, not as the challenged means itself. Alternatively, the later scene may contrast with rather than interpret sea travel.

changed_reading.after: They exemplify effective but domain-bounded passage, whose possibility remains granted rather than autonomous.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later rupture of the sky is rendered through color and oil imagery. That second cross-domain comparison strengthens the focus comparison as a perceptual operation: an unfamiliar scale or event becomes readable through a familiar visible material.

activation_trace.role: A visible landmark supplies the focus comparison's recognizable perceptual form.
Splitting open supplies the transformed event that must be made perceptible.
Flower-like redness supplies a visible color mapping for the altered sky.
Oil or coating supplies the material texture used to render the transformation.

structural_cues: Both 55:24 and 55:37 close their scenes with a cross-domain comparison introduced by the same comparative construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two visually forceful comparisons; I infer a shared strategy of making scale and transformation perceivable. The alternative is that each comparison remains local and contributes no common hermeneutic function.

changed_reading.before: The mountain comparison estimates vessel size.
changed_reading.after: The mountain comparison is also a perceptual instrument that makes moving maritime scale cognitively graspable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later judgment scene explicitly links visible marks to recognition. It retroactively sharpens the fleet's landmark profile: conspicuous form can identify a condition or owner, not merely guide a traveler.

activation_trace.role: The distinguishing landmark supplies a visible sign attached to the focus fleet.
Recognition by an effect or mark supplies the sign-to-knowledge relation.
A visible imprint that makes its bearer known clarifies how appearance identifies.

structural_cues: 55:41 moves directly from recognition to visible marks, though in a punitive rather than beneficent scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit mark-recognition mechanism; I carry that mechanism backward to the focus landmark and infer that it witnesses stated ownership. The alternative confines marked recognition to the judgment scene alone.

changed_reading.before: The vessels are visible enough to orient observers.
changed_reading.after: Their conspicuous profiles also act as identifying signatures through which otherwise unseen governance becomes knowable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later movement becomes a closed circuit between two punitive termini. This negative mirror prevents treating motion itself as favor: the focus vessels are beneficial because their flow has course, limits, and governed direction rather than mere repetition.

activation_trace.role: A customary way supplies directed coursing that can be contrasted with captive circulation.
Circling around something supplies motion that returns without liberating passage.
A relation between endpoints supplies the closed two-pole circuit.
Scalding water supplies the harmful terminus that reverses water's earlier benefit.

structural_cues: 55:44 depicts repeated movement between punishment and heated water, reversing the affect of the earlier sea course.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies directed ship coursing and later captive circling; I infer that direction and granted destination, not motion alone, distinguish benefit. The alternative treats the two movements as unrelated narrative scenes.

changed_reading.before: Flow and mobility are inherently favorable.
changed_reading.after: The fleet's favor lies in governed, destination-bearing passage; motion can otherwise become confinement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later feminine figures, restricted gaze, and tented enclosure reactivate two form-distant focus branches: young women in the vessel noun and growing or being raised in its modifier. Sea and landmark anchors prevent replacement of the ship scene, leaving a controlled lexical double exposure.

The live alternative is that feminine morphology only agrees with the vessel plural and carries no human resonance.

changed_reading.before: The feminine forms are grammatically inert references to ships.
changed_reading.after: The ship scene remains primary but carries a faint, later-activated shadow of young women being raised and enclosed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from an aromatic-plant occurrence and distant motion branches into sailing technology. It remains anchored by the focus branches for lifted sails, scenting wind, flowing, and continuing provision; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy, never as the lexical gloss of the context word.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins flowing vessels to a modifier whose branches include both lifted sails and sensing wind.

activation_trace.role: Lifted sails supply the surface that converts wind into visible elevation.
Sensing wind by lifting it toward the nose supplies an exploratory perception mechanism.
Continuing provision supplies the practical yield of wind-enabled motion.
Rapid light movement supplies the impelling atmospheric analogy.
Wind and breeze supply the invisible force that the raised vessel profile makes visible.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the vessels are wind-reading engines that turn invisible air into visible lift, motion, and continuing benefit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The outlier is surprising because it reads monumental height through soft furnishings late in the surah. It remains materially anchored by the focus's explicit raised-sail branch and the later fluttering cover and patterned textile branches; downstream prose should qualify it as a texture-and-mechanics resonance, not claim that the later furnishings name sails.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's mountain-like profile can be produced by raised cloth rather than by a solid mountain-like mass.

activation_trace.role: Lifted sails supply the pliant material that generates the vessel's vertical silhouette.
Mountain landmarks supply the apparently massive result of that lightweight lift.

changed_reading.after: Their mountain-scale visibility paradoxically arises from light, flexible, wind-responsive textile architecture.

strongest_changes: The focus moved from a size comparison to sail-raised mobile landmarks produced by crossing horizontal flow with vertical lift.
The two-sea sequence recast vessels as visible participants in bounded convergence, non-transgression, and emergence.
The immediate refrain and later replenished flows recast possession as recurrently maintained bounty.
The traversal challenge distinguished granted, domain-bounded passage from unrestricted escape.
Later feminine and textile fields preserved controlled lexical and material double readings instead of forcing disambiguation.
summary.what_was_special: Four focus roots formed an unusually productive mechanism: movement becomes elevated, elevation becomes a visible mark, and the mark makes a governed maritime system legible. Context repeatedly changed the value of that mechanism without collapsing its coexisting artifact, route, gift, sign, and exploratory human or textile readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The modifier can foreground raised sails, constructed vessels, or origination; the packet keeps all three live without fixing their grammatical weighting.
The final comparison may foreground concrete mountains, navigational signs, or both.
The maintained-provision and authorized-traversal models depend on contextual analogy rather than an explicit claim that ships perform those larger functions.
The late feminine, wind, and textile echoes are branch-backed but their backward reach remains deliberately exploratory.
